title: The crystal structure of a trisisoxazole compound: 3‐(3‐Methyl‐5‐isoxazolyl)methyl‐5‐(3‐methyl‐5‐isoxazolyl)methylisoxazole
abstract: AbstractThe crystal structure of a trisisoxazole derivative is described. The crystals are monoclinic, space group P21/c (Z = 4) with cell dimensions: a = 8.846(4), b = 26.688(7), c = 9.081(4) Ä, β = 142.82(7)0. The structure was refined by full matrix least squares to a final R of 0.060. The molecule is non‐planar and the bond lengths and angles are in the expected range for isoxazole derivatives.
